rule_title: TTP 1003 - Private Key Accessed via CAPI2 (Mimikatz crypto Module)
description: Detects private key access events via the CAPI2 Operational channel (EID 70). This event fires whenever a private key stored in the Windows certificate store is accessed or exported. Mimikatz's 'crypto' module (crypto::capi, crypto::cng) uses this to export private keys from the machine store. Multiple EID 70 events in rapid succession from a non-standard context indicates automated key extraction rather than a legitimate TLS operation or code signing.
